# Circle of Death (`spells:circle-of-death`)
**Level 6 [Necromancy](../magic-schools/necromancy.md)** | **Casting Time:** Action | **Range:** 150 feet
**Components:** V, S, M (the powder of a crushed black, pearl worth 500+ GP) | **Duration:** Instantaneous | **Classes:** [Sorcerer](../classes/sorcerer.md), [Warlock](../classes/warlock.md), [Wizard](../classes/wizard.md)
**Damage Type:** [Necrotic](../damage-types/necrotic.md)

Negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot-radius Sphere from a point you choose within range. Each creature in that area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one.

**Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot.** The damage increases by 2d8 for each spell slot level above 6.

| Slot Level | Damage |
|---|---|
| 6 | 8d8 |
